input:
Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At the painful reaction, add a more concrete physical detail: “他的肚子疼得不得了，马上躺在地上。”
2. You could make the plants more vivid by describing a feature he notices: “有的植物开着黄色的小花，又大又漂亮。”

ideas.reason: This gives a concrete reaction to the stomach pain and fits the story.
“小花” and “又大” conflict when both describe the flowers.
